review_type: Source and software review; independent clinician and oncology-pharmacist sign-off pending.

comparisons.finding: The established definitive weekly cisplatin plus radiation route stays available. The new source adds pembrolizumab for its specific FIGO 2014 III–IVA cohort. The two regimens have different systemic therapy and eligibility.
comparisons.verification: Retained portal and knowledge identity, exact guide bytes and shared setting routing where available in the browser audit.

comparisons.finding: Limited-stage small-cell lung cancer keeps its original portal and its small-cell lung identity. The separate cervical route uses the 00279b indication. The tumour site must be known.
comparisons.verification: Retained portal and knowledge identity, exact guide bytes and shared setting routing where available in the browser audit.

comparisons.finding: The metastatic breast route keeps its 28-day calendar. The ovarian portal covers the nine ovarian, tubal and peritoneal indications. The routine marrow threshold at equality was corrected after examining the printed underlines in Table 1.
comparisons.verification: Retained portal and knowledge identity, exact guide bytes and shared setting routing where available in the browser audit.

comparisons.finding: The metastatic breast route keeps its 21-day calendar. The new cohort-neutral ovarian portal covers the nine ovarian, tubal and peritoneal indications and requires explicit confirmation of the selected treatment setting.
comparisons.verification: Retained portal and knowledge identity, exact guide bytes and shared setting routing where available in the browser audit.

comparisons.finding: Locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma uses the separate cisplatin-unsuitable AUC 5 chemoradiation indication. Its three-cycle course must stay within head and neck material.
comparisons.verification: Retained portal and knowledge identity, exact guide bytes and shared setting routing where available in the browser audit.
